deterministic_conclusion: The chained controller enabled 8bit-high to complete a selective, sequential, grounded ReviewGraphen workflow and produce one independently issue-worthy finding. The 4bit-low trial reused one token across parallel requests, exceeded the tool budget, and timed out without a report; the controller rejected stale-token requests and preserved state.
interpretation_ceiling: This is one replicate per jointly varied quantization/effort cell. It supports a configuration-associated difference, not a causal estimate for quantization or effort separately. Chaining mechanically enforced sequentiality, so success does not show that 8bit-high would voluntarily serialize an unconstrained interface.
